label: sparse, diffuse: after "s m" early in original phase / early copy steps
explanation: Very sparse feature (0.03% of steps). Activation mass splits roughly evenly between the original phase (t=3..6, often just after the bigram s-m or s-s, input e/c/i/l) and early copy steps (recall_idx 1-2, mostly in sequences starting with u/e/n). It never fires at t=0..2 and almost never at the delimiter. Every token/position predicate tried (prev_tok=m, s-m bigram, recall_idx=1 with first token u/e/n, out/next_out token sets) reaches precision of 0.1 or less and F1 under 0.05, so firing seems to depend on a specific hidden-state configuration that these variables do not capture. Magnitude is narrow (median 0.12, max 0.215) and no clear modulator was found.
